purpose: Clarify historical-baseline definitions and add the exact pre-existing production default, without selecting from reporting results.
already_available_findings: The stored first15-member ensemble and frozen CVAE paths have been described; new refits are still running. No new hyperparameter, checkpoint or favourable seed is chosen from these outcomes.

additional_current_default_case.reason: The current production source and stored models explicitly use random_state42 and CUDA. Measure that pre-existing configuration as well as the planned17/29/43 CPU refits. This also gives a measured same-P2000 comparison with the frozen CVAE costs.
additional_current_default_case.checkpoint_selection: Existing default early stopping on validation, full residual/drift calibration; no tuning.
additional_current_default_case.selection_role: Always report this predetermined current-default case, whether better or worse. Do not replace the validation-frozen CVAE recommendation.

original_H2RES_baselines.as_used_in_original_published_benchmark: All original WTON capacity weights, including offshore; PHOT solar; training-only temperature climatology proxy.
original_H2RES_baselines.onshore_sensitivity: Also show the onshore-only original reference because the climate wind source differs spatially. Retain both cases; do not silently replace the published reference.
original_H2RES_baselines.hour_scope: Use every non-leap hour of2020-2024 (43800). Old tables excluded the first168hours and sometimes used100-member means, so preserve their numbers separately rather than calling the new table identical.

stored_ensemble_identifiers: Three groups of five existing members are bookkeeping groups, not newly generated RNG seeds. Their original seed/code version cannot be certified from the array alone.
operational_guard_repair: The first default GPU case deferred before fitting because our active CPU-only XGBoost child registered a GPU context. In this new comparison folder only, classify an active queue-owned CPU hybrid child by exact PID, cwd, script and CPU device; unrelated Python/CUDA processes still defer our GPU work. Retry the same fixed seed42/configuration in a new directory, retaining the deferred attempt. No outcome-based tuning.

completed_original_consumer_case.role: Already prespecified and frozen in the overnight study, not a new fitted model or a new selected seed. Include its archived reporting paths as a strong actualCPU900 comparator; the selected GPU architecture is not automatically the best CPU design.
